description: Free, no account needed. Search the three.ws documentation for the section that answers a question, such as "how do I embed an avatar on my site" or "how does auto-rigging work". Returns the best sections ranked, each with the page and heading title, a url that opens the docs reader at that heading, and a snippet from the start of the section. Use this before guessing at an API or a flow; to browse ready-made 3D assets call search_catalog instead.
